about: Simply Solventless Concentrates Ltd. cultivates, processes, formulates, manufactures, and sells a portfolio of terpene-rich solventless concentrates for the recreational, medical, and business-to-business cannabis markets in Canada. It operates through three segments: MHF / ANC Operations, CannMart, and Humble Grow. The MHF / ANC Operations segment processes and manufactures pre-rolls and concentrate products, including tolling and white-label services from Alberta facilities. The CannMart segment produces and sells vapes, pre-rolls, concentrates, and edibles under owned brands and third-party white-label arrangements and also functions as a logistical center. The Humble Grow segment operates a Good Agricultural and Collection Practices certified cannabis cultivation facility in Manitoba, servicing recreational and wholesale markets. Simply Solventless Concentrates Ltd. was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Calgary, Canada.
